description: Voice configuration representing the doodle channel signature sound. Note: Input text must have lines joined with spaces for sentence_silence to apply correctly, which is handled automatically by the piper_tts tool.

script_guidelines.sentence_pauses: The piper_tts tool automatically normalizes newlines to spaces so that sentence_silence is properly applied by the engine.
script_guidelines.emotional_expression: Use dramatic punctuation (..., !, ?, —) to guide natural pauses and human-like voice inflections.
script_guidelines.emphasis_capitalization: ALL CAPS words longer than 3 characters are automatically converted to lowercase by piper_tts during generation to prevent letter-by-letter spelling, while keeping visual emphasis in on-screen captions.
